provider.name: Contabo
provider.reason: The provider VIP/L4 service must be provisioned outside Kubernetes; no provider credential or live infrastructure access is stored in this repository.

backends.fencing: Remove a failed backend from every provider pool and deny provider-LB-to-backend traffic at the node firewall before repair; never run keepalived or a second VIP owner on the nodes.

httpListener.healthSignal: The 443 HTTPS health check gates the node; port 80 is forwarded only for the existing HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect.

networkBoundary.rule: The provider VIP forwards only 80/443 to Traefik and 6443 to the Kubernetes API. No etcd, kubelet, overlay, Longhorn, metrics, SSH, or arbitrary node port is a listener or health-check target. Backend firewalls must allow 6443 only from the provider LB health/data-plane addresses and keep all denied ports unavailable from the Internet and provider LB.

ownershipAndRecovery.splitBrainPrevention: Do not assign the VIP to a node or publish both the provider VIP and backend A records after cutover.
ownershipAndRecovery.withdrawal: Three consecutive failed checks withdraw a backend; two consecutive successful checks return it after operator review. Existing connections may drain according to provider policy; new connections must not be sent to a withdrawn backend.
ownershipAndRecovery.apiRecovery: Restore k3s readiness and certificate identity first, verify /readyz through the provider VIP, then re-enable the backend. Do not re-add a node solely because its TCP port is open.
ownershipAndRecovery.edgeRecovery: Restore Traefik and the public HTTPS /health journey, verify SNI/certificate and one representative route, then re-enable the backend.
ownershipAndRecovery.providerFailure: If the provider VIP is unavailable, keep the passive DNS records and use the manual removal procedure; do not create a second unreviewed VIP or change kubeconfigs during an incident.

evidence.limitation: No live provider VIP, firewall change, certificate reissue, or failure injection was performed by this change; evidence must be produced by an authorized operator and must not be backfilled from estimates.
